outs.note: The show said Trey Murphy III and Bennedict Mathurin are doubtful for Nov. 13, and Yves Missi could return. Murphy has not played since Nov. 8. The show said Jordan Poole gets a bump and is playable for value.
Yves Missi has a left knee contusion and bone bruise from Oct. 23 and has missed every game since. He is listed as doubtful for Friday against Memphis.

Klay Thompson and Pelle Larsson are both questionable for Miami on Nov 13, which puts about 60 minutes in doubt. The show said Bobby Portis, Andrew Wiggins or Ryan Conwell could pick up value if both sit.
The show said Pelle Larsson and Klay Thompson are both questionable for Nov. 13 and Giannis Antetokounmpo is probable. The show prefers Larsson to Thompson if he plays.

outs.note: Evan Mobley is out for Cleveland on Nov 13 with a left great toe sprain. He started and played 33 minutes on Nov 11. The show said his absence pushes extra minutes to Jarrett Allen, Jaylon Tyson and possibly Mario Hezonja, and that it also makes Miami's matchup better.
Sam Merrill is out for Cleveland on Nov 13. The show listed him with Evan Mobley as absences that open up playing time for other Cavaliers.
Capela started on Oct. 30 with Alperen Sengun and Steven Adams out, but he is now out himself. He missed Nov. 2 with a right ankle sprain.

The show said Marcus Smart is out on Nov. 13. He has played 17 to 20 minutes off the bench lately. The show said Reed Sheppard and Tari Eason get bumps, though they are not in great spots against Utah.
Precious Achiuwa started but left after 14 minutes with a lower leg contusion, according to the show. His status for Friday's game against Portland was not given.

outs.note: Curry left after six minutes with an abdominal injury, and Shams Charania reported it is an oblique abdominal tear with a re-evaluation in two weeks. The show said he will not be back in two weeks and expects him to miss over a month.

injuries.text: Joel Embiid left early in the first quarter after banging knees with Ja'Kobe Walter, but he returned later in the quarter. He finished with 20 points in 28 minutes, and the show said he moved as well as he has in quite some time.
